digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, G7 criterion, threshold routing and blocking logic
propositions: G7 criterion has never blocked due to default_posture 'advisory' at 0.95 threshold; historical FP verification over 348 findings shows 0 clearly-incorrect at priority >= 0.85, supporting a blocking posture at 0.85 threshold.

G7 routing entry must change from default_posture 'advisory' with block_threshold 0.95 to default_posture 'blocking' with block_threshold 0.85, following the precedent set by bfa8 and c97a enablements.

Plan-review blocking behavior is determined solely by default_posture == 'blocking' and block_threshold via threshold_for() in model.py; impact_plan grades divergence by kind (contradicts_reality and omits_required_site floor at 1.0, incomplete_enumeration contributes 0.55) to produce the blocking or advisory result.

G7 rubric must be updated with four new guidance rules: abstain-with-coverage on unresolvable parent (FAIL-OPEN pattern), closed-parent final-state checking with sibling-handoff scoping, one finding per contradicted parent clause (DEDUP-AT-SOURCE pattern), and explicit floor-kind guidance to prevent cosmetic mismatches from blocking.

Pinned assertions in test_threshold_recalibration.py, test_impact_model_versioning.py, and test_plan_review_g7.py must reflect G7 at (0.85, 'blocking'); new tests/unit/plan_review/test_g7_blocking.py must verify real Pass-3 wrapper behavior with real impact_plan across all divergence kinds and boundary cases.
Monitoring follow-up (non-AC): re-run FP classification once >= 20 kind-graded G7 findings accumulate in REVIEW_RESULT corpus to validate blocking effectiveness.
